title: Record-by-record reconciliation: TMD FY 2569 S-band radar tenders
scope: Four TMD project IDs checked against the official TMD award/contract summary and the fresh project-specific e-GP getProcureResult response.
mapping_rule: The project ID and station name are the primary key. Prices are never reassigned between stations based on order, search-result position, or a transient empty tab.
